_: Stjernekikkeren in English: Stargazer. A «felt» (a patch of sky with its own colour and pattern) is an «area».
Two stars in the same row.
Two stars in the same column.
Two stars in the same area.
Alle stjernene står, men noen bryter reg: All the stars are placed, but some break the rules. Look for the exclamation marks.
Brettet er tømt. Angre henter det tilbak: The board is cleared. Undo brings it back.
Det er bare én plass igjen i denne raden: There is only one place left in this row.
Det er bare én plass igjen i denne kolon: There is only one place left in this column.
Det er bare én plass igjen i dette felte: There is only one place left in this area.
En vrien en: Her skal det stå en stjerne: A tricky one: a star belongs here.
Du har brukt alle hintene: You have used all your hints
That star was in the wrong place. It has been removed.
{n} stars were in the wrong place. They have been removed.
Der du satte prikk, skal det stå en stje: A star belongs where you put a dot. The dot has been removed.
Det skal stå stjerner der du satte {n} a: Stars belong where you put {n} of your dots. They have been removed.
Sett én stjerne i hver rad, hver kolonne: Place one star in every row, every column and every area of the sky. The stars may not touch each other – not even diagonally.
Ett trykk setter en prikk der det ikke k: One tap puts a dot where a star can't go. The next tap places a star, and the third empties the square.
Dra fingeren over flere ruter for å prik: Drag your finger across several squares to dot them all at once.
To stjerner i samme rad, kolonne eller f: Two stars in the same row, column or area – or touching each other – are marked with an exclamation mark.
Begynn med de minste feltene. Der er det: Start with the smallest areas. They have the fewest places to choose from.
Ligger et helt felt i én rad, må radens: If a whole area lies in one row, that row's star must be in that area. Then you can dot out the rest of the row.
Med Autoprikk på viser brettet selv, med: With Auto-dots on, the board shows with faint dots where your stars block other stars.
Feltene har egen farge, eget mønster og: Every area has its own colour, its own pattern and thick edges, so you can see them without telling colours apart.
Stuck? You get three hints per board. Every board has only one solution, so you never need to guess.
Dagens stjernehimmel er den samme for al: Today's sky is the same for everyone: small on Monday, big at the weekend.
Med tastatur: piltaster flytter, mellomr: With a keyboard: the arrow keys move, Space marks, S places a star, X places a dot, Backspace empties, H gives a hint and P pauses.
One star in every row, column and area.
Hvert brett er nytt og har bare én løsni: Every board is new and has only one solution – you never need to guess.
The sky is waiting for you.
Du løste dagens stjernehimmel på {tid} f: You solved today's sky in {tid} the first time.
Alle i hele landet får den samme himmele: Everyone in the country gets the same sky today.
Uten hint! Alle i hele landet får den sa: No hints! Everyone in the country gets the same sky today.
Første brett på {str} – nå har du en rek: First board on {str} – now you have a record to beat!
Trykk én gang for prikk, to ganger for s: Tap once for a dot, twice for a star.
Her må det stå en stjerne – se hvor de a: A star must go here – look at where the other stars block.
